texts.together: Weeks later, you and {who} are still finding excuses to be in the same place.
texts.alone: The season ends, and you walk out of it on your own terms.
texts.leftAlone: By the end, there is no one left waiting for you.

reasons.Dealbreaker: {who} could not get past what you did.
reasons.Suspicion: {who} stopped believing they were the only one.
reasons.BrokenPromises: {who} got tired of waiting for you.
reasons.Neglect: {who} decided you were not coming back.
